# Source Map — LAW-005 (December 2022 fuel-stimulus agreement) — VERIFIED

**Source role:** executive_legislative_record (administrative "Acuerdo" by SHCP, not a statute or decree). **Locator scope:** units 1–2 (Acuerdo consent text + Articles Primero–Cuarto + Transitorio Único).

## Atomic claims

**C1 — Issuing authority and instrument type**
- Observed: "ACUERDO … Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público," signed by Karina Ramírez Arras, Titular de la Unidad de Política de Ingresos no Tributarios, acting "en suplencia del C. Subsecretario de Hacienda y Crédito Público" (units 1, 2).
- Document type: Acuerdo 173/2022; signed "Ciudad de México, a 08 de diciembre de 2022" (unit 2).

**C2 — Legal basis (parent decrees)**
- Cited authority: "Decreto por el que se establecen estímulos fiscales en materia del impuesto especial sobre producción y servicios aplicables a los combustibles que se indican, publicado en el Diario Oficial de la Federación el 27 de diciembre de 2016 y sus posteriores modificaciones" (unit 1).
- Cited authority: "Decreto por el que se establecen estímulos fiscales complementarios a los combustibles automotrices, publicado en el Diario Oficial de la Federación el 4 de marzo de 2022" (unit 1).

**C3 — Period covered**
- "Periodo comprendido del 10 al 16 de diciembre de 2022," seven-day window (unit 1; restated in Arts. Primero–Cuarto).

**C4 — IEPS stimulus percentages (Art. Primero)**
- Gasolina menor a 91 octanos: 26.96%.
- Gasolina mayor o igual a 91 octanos y combustibles no fósiles: 0.00%.
- Diésel: 59.77%.

**C5 — Fiscal stimulus amounts in pesos/litro (Art. Segundo)**
- Gasolina menor a 91 octanos: $1.4803.
- Gasolina mayor o igual a 91 octanos y combustibles no fósiles: $0.0000.
- Diésel: $3.6071.

**C6 — Reduced IEPS cuota pesos/litro (Art. Tercero)**
- Gasolina menor a 91 octanos: $4.0114.
- Gasolina mayor o igual a 91 octanos y combustibles no fósiles: $4.6375.
- Diésel: $2.4283.

**C7 — Complementary stimulus per litre (Art. Cuarto)**
- All three categories: $0.0000 for the 10–16 Dec 2022 period.

**C8 — Entry into force**
- "TRANSITORIO ÚNICO.- El presente Acuerdo entrará en vigor al día siguiente de su publicación en el Diario Oficial de la Federación." Signed "Ciudad de México, a 08 de diciembre de 2022" (unit 2). Publication date not stated in the extract.

## Status, scope, and qualifications

- **Status:** weekly/routine Acuerdo issued under standing IEPS decrees (Decreto de estímulos fiscales IEPS combustibles, 27-dic-2016; Decreto de estímulos fiscales complementarios a combustibles automotrices, 4-mar-2022) — not a new statute, budget appropriation, or emergency decree; no fiscal cost, appropriation, or funding source stated in this text.
- **Targeting:** defined by fuel category only; no income, region, or firm-size eligibility in the extract; complementary Art. Cuarto set to zero, so only the base IEPS stimulus (Arts. Primero–Tercero) is operative this week.
- **Administrative design:** SHCP sets per-litre rates; downstream fuel retailers/prices are not addressed in the extract. No monitoring, reporting, audit, or correction mechanism appears.
- **Stated rationale:** none in extract; no inflation, transport-cost, or social-stability purpose clause.
- **Duration:** one calendar week; transitory entry only. Any durable-trajectory or recurrent claim unsupported by this text.

## Source role vs. question needs

The Acuerdo is an **executive regulatory instrument** implementing pre-existing IEPS decrees. For 5B.1/5B.3/5B.6/5B.7/5B.9/5B.10 it supplies only the per-litre IEPS stimulus parameters for 10–16 Dec 2022; it does **not** show household incidence, fiscal cost, budget execution, monitoring, or market impact.

## Limitations / reopen notes for stronger model

- No published date, fiscal cost, appropriation, or coverage statistics; budget documents required for cost claims.
- "Estímulos complementarios" set to $0 — verify whether simultaneous complementary decree or federal-program transfers applied (e.g., IEPS gasolinera periodo coincidente).
- Period is one week; aggregate 2022 picture requires the series of Acuerdos, parent 2016 and 4-Mar-2022 decrees, and any amendments.
- Counterfactual (no estímulo) and regressive-incidence assessments cannot be drawn from this text.
- Verify whether any 2022 modifications of the 27-Dec-2016 decree altered the parameters published here.

## Contrary / alternative material

- None in extract. Critical readings (fiscal cost, regressivity, distortion, lack of monitoring) cannot be evidenced from this Acuerdo; would require Presupuesto de Egresos, Cuenta Pública, SHCP reports, or independent evaluations.

## Verification notes

- Verbatim free-text quotas, percentages, and peso amounts in C4–C7 match the four tables in the extract verbatim.
- Signatory title in C1 matches the extract verbatim, including lower-case "no Tributarios" in the issuing paragraph; the closing Transitorio Único uses the capitalized form "Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios" — both forms appear in the source, so the lowercase "no Tributarios" form in the opening paragraph is preserved where it appears.
- C8 corrected: the Transitorio Único in the extract refers to publication in the DOF as the trigger, but does not itself state a publication date; the draft's "publication date not present" note is therefore retained as accurate.
- No additions inserted; no claims reworded beyond the minor signatory-title consistency above.

## VERIFIED ADDITIONS
- None.

## REOPEN REQUESTS
- None.
